verdict.rationale: Ask Fern indexes the user's documentation and gives end users an interface to ask questions, and its responses include citations that link directly to source pages. Supporting features include a customizable AI disclaimer and automated review of unanswered Ask Fern questions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of answer and citation quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an embedded AI assistant on my docs site answers reader questions with citations into my content

citations.quote: Ask Fern indexes your documentation and provides an interface for your end users to ask questions and get answers. Responses include citations that link directly to source pages.
You can now replace the default Ask Fern disclaimer (“Responses are generated using AI and may contain mistakes.”) with your own wording.
